company.name: RightNow
company.shortDescription: RightNow provides consumers with access to justice by purchasing legal claims and paying a large proportion of the claim within 24h.
company.description: RightNow is a consumer factoring provider and one of the most successful German legaltech startups. With its products, RightNow buys consumer claims from everyday life situations and pays a large part of the reimbursement within only 24 hours. The claims are assessed using specially developed algorithms and enforced in court through highly automated processes.

productsAndServices.description: RightNow purchases legal claims from consumers and pays a large portion of the claim within days, relieving consumers from pursuing lengthy legal processes.
productsAndServices.name: Legal Claim Purchase and Immediate Compensation

productsAndServices.description: RightNow buys claims from consumers whose energy providers unlawfully terminated contracts, offering immediate compensation for increased energy costs.
productsAndServices.name: Energy Contract Compensation Service

productsAndServices.description: RightNow purchases claims from consumers who lost money on illegal online gambling platforms and provides immediate partial reimbursement.
productsAndServices.name: Online Gambling Loss Compensation

productsAndServices.description: RightNow buys claims from consumers overcharged by private health insurers and offers immediate partial refunds for unlawful premium increases.
productsAndServices.name: Private Health Insurance Premium Overcharge Compensation

productsAndServices.description: RightNow purchases claims from individuals affected by the Deezer data breach and offers immediate compensation for damages related to the data leak.
productsAndServices.name: Data Breach Compensation Service (Deezer Data Breach)

productsAndServices.description: RightNow buys claims from Netflix customers for improper price increases and provides immediate partial refunds.
productsAndServices.name: Netflix Price Increase Refund Service

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $3,678,508, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,565,761 to $18,759,113, a 5.26x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 68 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 67 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
